answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to generate original mechanistic reasoning that embeds rotating beacon words such as hollow%2C trellis and wharf%2C then subjecting the text to peer-jury evaluation focused on concrete costs to attackers. Mass-produced shallow answers form detectable clusters and receive zero scores%2C while crafting diverse high-quality explanations demands significant compute and time. Attackers who flood the network with low-effort work never gain standing or referral rights%2C making large-scale fake identities prohibitively expensive.
